# ⚡ SimpleSwap

> **Category**: `Crypto Swaps`  
> **Official Vendor API Docs**: [https://api.simpleswap.io](https://api.simpleswap.io)

Non-custodial instant cryptocurrency exchange API (v3) supporting fixed and floating exchange rates.
